title: General Inspection Report
description: Free General Inspection Report template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers inspection information, section 1: exterior conditions, section 2: interior conditions.
html:
Inspection Information

INSPECTOR: ______________ TITLE: ______________

Section 1: Exterior Conditions

☐ Parking lots and walkways in good condition

☐ No standing water, ice, or debris

☐ Lighting adequate and functioning

☐ Fencing and gates in good condition

☐ Loading docks safe and accessible

☐ Waste disposal areas clean and contained

☐ Emergency vehicle access clear

☐ Signage visible and in good condition

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 2: Interior Conditions

☐ Floors clean, dry, and in good condition

☐ Walls, ceilings, and partitions in good condition

☐ Adequate lighting throughout

☐ Temperature comfortable and consistent

☐ Ventilation adequate

☐ No water leaks or damage

☐ No unusual odors

☐ Housekeeping satisfactory

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 3: Aisles, Passageways & Exits

☐ Aisles and passageways clearly marked

☐ Minimum 28" clearance maintained

☐ No obstructions in aisles

☐ Floor markings visible

☐ Exits clearly marked with illuminated signs

☐ Exit doors open easily without keys or tools

☐ Emergency lighting functional

☐ No storage within 36" of electrical panels

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 4: Workstations & Office Areas

☐ Workstations ergonomically arranged

☐ Chairs in good condition and adjustable

☐ Computer monitors at proper height

☐ No tripping hazards (cords, etc.)

☐ Storage organized and safe

☐ File cabinets stable and not overfilled

☐ Work surfaces clean and organized

☐ Emergency procedures posted

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 5: Restrooms & Break Areas

☐ Restrooms clean and sanitary

☐ Adequate supplies (soap, paper towels)

☐ Hot and cold water available

☐ No leaks or plumbing issues

☐ Ventilation adequate

☐ Break areas clean and organized

☐ Refrigerator clean and food properly stored

☐ Coffee makers and microwaves in good condition

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 6: Chemical Storage & Handling

☐ All containers properly labeled

☐ SDS available for all chemicals

☐ Chemicals stored by compatibility

☐ Secondary containment in place

☐ Flammable storage in approved cabinets

☐ Spill kits available and accessible

☐ PPE available for chemical handling

☐ No expired or deteriorated chemicals

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 7: Emergency Equipment

☐ Fire extinguishers inspected and tagged

☐ Extinguishers properly mounted and accessible

☐ Eye wash stations functional and accessible

☐ Safety showers functional and accessible

☐ First aid kits stocked and accessible

☐ AED available and in working order

☐ Emergency numbers posted

☐ Emergency evacuation maps posted

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 8: Hazardous Energy Control (Loto)

☐ Energy isolation devices identified

☐ Locks and tags available

☐ LOTO procedures posted or accessible

☐ Employees trained and authorized

☐ Annual inspections completed

☐ Group lockout equipment available

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 9: Personal Protective Equipment (Ppe)

☐ PPE available in appropriate sizes

☐ PPE in good condition

☐ Employees wearing required PPE

☐ Head protection available and used

☐ Eye protection available and used

☐ Hand protection available and used

☐ Foot protection available and used

☐ Hearing protection available and used

COMMENTS: ______________

______________

Section 10: Documentation & Records

☐ Training records complete and up-to-date

☐ Safety meeting minutes on file

☐ Incident reports complete

☐ Equipment inspection records current

☐ Permit to work documentation on file

☐ JSA/SWMS available for current tasks

☐ Contractor orientation records on file
